name: Wild Turkey
description: The Wild Turkey is a large ground-foraging bird of woodlands and nearby clearings. Flocks often emerge along field edges and roadsides early in the morning, walking steadily as they search for food. Courting males transform their outline by puffing up their feathers and spreading their tails, accompanied by resonant gobbling. Once greatly reduced by hunting, the species recovered through restoration efforts. A quiet woodland encounter offers a chance to appreciate its patterned feathers and the social movements of a flock.

references.title: Cornell Lab of Ornithology: All About Birds
